# Programs that production code starts (Command::new, Runner argv[0]) and where they come from. Read by
# crates/iyakki-agent/tests/image_programs.rs (./run.sh image-programs): a program the scan finds that is not listed here FAILS the test,
# so a new dependency on a program the image does not ship (the `curl` bug, 2026-10-27) cannot arrive unnoticed.
#
#   image    <program> busybox | <BR2_PACKAGE_SYMBOL>   shipped; the symbol must appear in dist/buildroot/configs
#   optional <program> <why>   not in the default image: downloaded at the person's click, a later add-on, or only run after has() says it exists
#   host     <program> <why>   a developer machine, macOS or Windows path; never runs on the image
#   gap      <program> <why>   used on a real image path although the image lacks it: a known open item (the test prints these)
#   exempt   <path-part> <why>  a source file whose literal "curl"/"jq"/"python3"/"perl" is a command-policy list, advice text or the like
#
# busybox in the image is Buildroot's default applet set.
image /bin/sh busybox
image sh busybox
image env busybox
image ip BR2_PACKAGE_IPROUTE2
image kill busybox
image ps busybox
image dmesg busybox
image mknod busybox
image modprobe busybox
image mdev busybox
image udhcpc busybox
image amixer BR2_PACKAGE_ALSA_UTILS_AMIXER
image aplay BR2_PACKAGE_ALSA_UTILS_APLAY
image arecord BR2_PACKAGE_ALSA_UTILS
image git BR2_PACKAGE_GIT
image ssh BR2_PACKAGE_DROPBEAR_CLIENT
optional kubectl downloaded with the k3s program at the person's click; callers ask has("kubectl") first
optional k3s downloaded at the person's click (docs/K3S-DEV.md)
optional podman only in the cluster fragment (iyakki_cluster.fragment), not in the default image
optional docker a developer machine's engine, never in the image
host npx developer machine (coverage runs)
host xdg-open a desktop session only (webengine::host_session); the image uses its own browser
host rustc developer machine
host rustup developer machine
host apt-cache Debian or Ubuntu desktop (Linux apps tile)
exempt cli.rs the restricted command shell's own "curl" built-in
exempt grants.rs command-policy list (programs that are never auto-approved)
exempt autopilot.rs command-policy list (programs the autopilot knows)
exempt boardtrack.rs words that classify a task, not a spawn
exempt devcluster.rs command-policy text: what a command would download
exempt flows/programs.rs allowed-program list of flow steps; a flow step reports a missing program itself
exempt linuxapps_init.rs installs curl inside a Debian guest, not on the image
exempt dockerlint.rs advice text about Dockerfiles
exempt clis.rs known-CLI catalogue (names to look for on the person's PATH)
exempt coverage.rs developer machine only
exempt boardtools.rs words that classify a task
exempt store/author.rs text for the person who writes a store entry
exempt regsetup.rs advice text: a command to run on the node
optional gst-launch-1.0 only run by the boot self-test when the web engine's MP3 plugin file exists (web images ship it)
optional gst-inspect-1.0 only run by the boot self-test (web-recorder) when the web engine's MP3 plugin file exists (web images ship it)
